translated_title: Mexico's Government Plans to Maintain Oil Production at 1.8 Million Barrels per Day Through 2039
original_title: Gobierno prevé mantener producción petrolera en 1.8 millones de barriles diarios hasta 2039
author: Julio Gutiérrez
meta_description: Sener's new 15-year Hydrocarbons Plan tilts output toward the domestic market over exports and moves to curb gas imports, 89% of which private firms handled in 2024.
